description: This file is a Perl script defining functions and variables for generating x86 NASM assembly code, specifically for the OpenSSL project, related to BoringSSL's perlasm assembly generation.

methods.name: ::generic
methods.description: Optimizes and emits assembly instructions based on opcode and arguments.

methods.name: ::call
methods.description: Emits a call instruction, with label decoration.

methods.name: ::call_ptr
methods.description: Emits a call instruction with pointer.

methods.name: ::jmp_ptr
methods.description: Emits a jump instruction with pointer.

methods.name: get_mem
methods.description: Constructs a memory operand string for assembly instructions.

methods.name: ::file
methods.description: Outputs assembly section directives based on environment.

methods.name: ::function_begin_B
methods.description: Starts a function label and setup for assembly output.

methods.name: ::function_end_B
methods.description: Ends a function label and cleans up labels.

methods.name: ::file_end
methods.description: Finalizes assembly output, handling specific symbols.

methods.name: ::picmeup
methods.description: Loads address of symbol into register.
